transcription.text: Born down in a dead man's town The first kick I took was when I hit the ground End up like a dog that's been beat too much Till you spend half your life just to cover it up, now  Born in the U.S.A. I had a brother at Khe Sanh Fighting off the Viet Cong They're still there, he's all gone  He had a woman he loved in Saigon I got a picture of them in his arms  Down in the shadow of the penitentiary Out by the gas fires of the refinery I'm ten years burning down the road Nowhere to run, ain't got nowhere to go  Born in the U.S.A.
